Power = 1.6 MW per 2 kH = 0.8 MW per kH!\nfor L in [11, 13, 15, 17]:\n    term_N_24 = (0.75 * 40.0 * (0.98**(24 - L))) / 2.0 # per kH!\n    usable_vendor = max(0, 24 - (L + 3))\n    usable_brokerA = max(0, 24 - (L + 2))\n    net_capex_vendor = 20.0 - term_N_24\n    # Broker A: 1.10 * 20 = $22M/kH if delivered (90% if reliable), if cancelled 20% loss of $22M = $4.4M/kH!\n    # Wait! Check broker refund math!\n    print(f\"Gen N launch L={L}: term credit/kH=${term_N_24:.3f}M, vendor net capex/kH=${net_capex_vendor:.3f}M over {usable_vendor} mos = ${net_capex_vendor/max(1,usable_vendor):.3f}M/kH-mo (excl power)\")\n'","time":{"start":1794663543557,"end":1794663543713}},"metadata":{"google":{"thoughtSignature":""}},"id":"prt_1da4872d0001UvAKNVBsVjLXWP","sessionID":"ses_e25b99d17ffeoHUDZaYlUlI3xZ","messageID":"msg_1da476598001JNbKBIK0gNQWmi"}}
